method: Actual delivered JavaScript executed in Node VM; DOM and localStorage are hand-written mocks, not a browser. No keyboard/rendering/axe claim.

tests.name: Actual quantity validator accepts only integers 1–99 or cart 0–99
Actual filters combine query, availability and price; recent order is deterministic
Actual add rejects preview-only, invalid and over-limit; integer-cent totals
Actual coupon submit reports error then applies BENCH10 with rounded totals
Actual cart update handler validates atomically, focuses error, then removes quantity zero
Actual checkout explanatory handler remains local
Actual Empty cart handler clears selections, coupon and totals; empty coupon rejected
Actual stored cart sanitizer rejects unknown, preview and fractional values
Actual blocked storage handling retains temporary state and discloses reset
Actual product submit rejects invalid quantity and adds encoder plus optional knob atomically
